request: Analyze GSE273579 for PMID 39357875 (Regular exercise suppresses steatosis-associated liver cancer development by degrading E2F1 and c-Myc via circadian gene upregulation.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NextSeq 500 SE76), mouse liver
final.model: neonatal DMBA + high-fat diet steatosis-associated liver cancer, male C57BL/6 mice; treadmill 18 m/min, 20 min/day, 5 d/wk for last 10 of 35 weeks
final.sample_inclusion: HFD-fed DMBA mice, n=4 per exercise arm; non-tumor and tumor liver tissue from each mouse; ND non-exercise mice (n=4) are a diet reference with no exercise arm
final.primary_estimand: Effect of regular treadmill exercise vs non-exercise on liver gene expression in DMBA/HFD mice, within non-tumor and within tumor tissue
planned_contrasts: HFD exercise vs HFD non-exercise, non-tumor liver (abstract: exercise vs non-exercise liver profiles; no DEG count in abstract)
HFD exercise vs HFD non-exercise, tumor tissue (GEO summary: RNA from non-tumor and tumor tissues; no DEG count in abstract)
final.repeated_measure_unit: mouse (tumor and non-tumor from the same liver); irrelevant within a tissue stratum
final.paper_results: Per1 and Cry2 up in exercise; E2F1 and c-Myc target genes down; E2f1 and Myc mRNA unchanged

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: No full text. Abstract (PubMed efetch) and GEO series summary/overall_design define the estimand: exercise vs non-exercise in HFD/DMBA livers; GEO says non-tumor and tumor tissue were both sequenced. Method and threshold are not stated.

checks: 20 GSM per-sample featureCounts files in GSE273579_RAW.tar match the 20 metadata samples

ownership.reasoning: GEO series links PMID 39357875 and shares the title.

alignment.reasoning: Tar columns become GSM ids and equal the metadata index (20/20). ex = exercise arm, tis = ND liver / HFD non-tumor / HFD tumor, from the treatment characteristic.

final.source: GSE273579_RAW.tar per-sample featureCounts outputs (last column = read counts), merged
final.paper_input: not stated in abstract; GEO data_processing: STAR + featureCounts raw count matrices

matrix.reasoning: Per-sample files are featureCounts outputs (header line '# Program:featureCounts v2.0.5'), integer fraction 1.0, library sizes 16-20 M. GEO data_processing says the supplementary files hold TPM, but the deposited files are raw featureCounts counts; recorded as a discrepancy.

candidates.value: pool tumor and non-tumor tissue in one exercise contrast
candidates.reason_rejected: tissue type dominates expression; GEO describes them as separate tissues; comparisons stay within tissue
diet contrast, not exercise; ND has no exercise arm

design.reasoning: Exercise is randomized among HFD/DMBA mice only, so each exercise contrast is within HFD and within one tissue (4 vs 4). The non-tumor liver is the primary analysis per the abstract's 'livers of the exercise and non-exercise groups'; tumor tissue is secondary. ND samples are not used in any contrast.

covariance.reasoning: Within a tissue stratum each mouse contributes one sample, so no blocking is needed; no batch or sequencing-run variable is recorded; all mice male, same age, euthanized the same day.

deviations: paper's DE method unknown; workflow default DESeq2 on raw counts

method.reasoning: Raw featureCounts counts support DESeq2; fitted separately in each tissue stratum.

final.deviation_note: Abstract states no threshold; BH padj < 0.05 without fold-change cutoff is the workflow default. Raw p < 0.05 is reported only as a labelled audit rule.

threshold.reasoning: No threshold in the abstract or GEO record.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the abstract and GEO description only; no paper DEG counts available.
Paper method and threshold unknown; workflow default used.

study.reasoning: Abstract: Per1, Cry2 up with exercise; E2f1 and Myc mRNA unchanged; E2F1/c-Myc targets down.
